caption:
why are Korean sunscreens different from US ones?

In June 2026, the FDA finalized bemotrizinol at up to 6%, the first new US sunscreen filter in over 25 years.

Five other filters sent to the FDA had not been cleared in its last published update. Korea works from its own approved list.

So Korean and US sunscreens aren't built from the same menu.

Send this to the friend stocking up on Korean sunscreen.

Sources: FDA press release, Jun 9, 2026. Federal Register, Jan 7, 2015.
